violations.text: Food items were observed adulterated insects, adulterated food items were voluntarily disposed of. Establishment is to continue to inspect food items for evidence of adulteration. Establishment is to dispose of any adulterated food items. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2026

The presence of pests is not controlled as evidenced by rodent activity, and insect activity. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to have licensed pest control company do a full evaluation of the establishment. Full evaluation and subsequent pest control reports must be available to inspector at time of reinspection. Establishment is to clean and sanize and an all effected areas and remove any and all dead pests. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2026
A cat was observed living in the establishment. Cat was removed during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigeration cases have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. NFCS must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2026
